# GCON code map

**Generated by `scripts/gen_codemap.py`. Do not edit by hand.** After changing a route, table, migration, environment variable, event, plan limit, permission, dashboard tab, test file or doc, run `python scripts/gen_codemap.py`. A test fails when this file is out of date.

Hand-written guides are listed under *Docs*. Start with `docs/WORKERS_AND_ENROLLMENT.md` for workers and `docs/CUSTOMER_SIDE_CARRYOVER.md` for wiring the customer site to the backend.

## Docs

- `docs/API.md` — GCON API Reference
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` — GCON Architecture
- `docs/BUILD_LOG.md` — GCON build log
- `docs/CUSTOMER_SIDE_CARRYOVER.md` — Customer-side carryover map
- `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md` — GCON Deployment & Operations Guide
- `docs/FAILOVER.md` — GCON Coordinator Failover (High Availability)
- `docs/QUICKSTART.md` — GCON Quick Start Guide
- `docs/TRANSPORT_AND_PERSISTENCE.md` — GCON Distributed Foundation: Transport Layer + Persistence Layer
- `docs/WORKERS_AND_ENROLLMENT.md` — Workers, enrollment and hosted leases
- `docs/WORKER_SANDBOX.md` — Sandboxed workers

## Customer API routes (organization API key)

39 routes. Scopes used: `Submit workflows`, `View monitoring`.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/account/plan` | Your plan, its limits, and your current job usage |
| GET | `/artifacts` | List all registered artifacts |
| GET | `/auth/api-keys` | List this organization's API keys |
| POST | `/auth/api-keys` | Create a new API key for this organization |
| DELETE | `/auth/api-keys/{key_id}` | Revoke an API key |
| POST | `/auth/change-password` | Change your password |
| POST | `/auth/delete-account` | Delete your account and workspace |
| POST | `/auth/forgot-password` | Request a password reset |
| POST | `/auth/login` | Log in: verify credentials and receive a session API key |
| POST | `/auth/reset-password` | Set a new password using a reset token |
| POST | `/auth/signup` | Create a new organization and customer account |
| GET | `/billing/invoices` | List your organization's invoices |
| GET | `/billing/invoices/{invoice_id}` | Get one of your organization's invoices |
| GET | `/billing/pricing` | Current price list |
| GET | `/billing/usage` | Preview your usage and charges for a period |
| GET | `/cluster` | Get current cluster state |
| GET | `/enroll/ca` | The coordinator's CA certificate and its fingerprint (public) |
| GET | `/health` | Get overall cluster health |
| GET | `/jobs` | List all jobs |
| POST | `/jobs` | Submit a new job |
| POST | `/jobs/clear` | Permanently clear failed or cancelled jobs |
| GET | `/jobs/{job_id}` | Get a single job by id |
| GET | `/jobs/{job_id}/attempts` | Durable dispatch-attempt history for a job |
| POST | `/jobs/{job_id}/cancel` | Cancel a queued or running job |
| POST | `/jobs/{job_id}/retry` | Retry a failed or stuck-pending job |
| GET | `/metrics` | Get aggregate node and job metrics |
| GET | `/nodes` | List all registered nodes |
| GET | `/nodes/{node_id}` | Get a single node by id |
| GET | `/nodes/{node_id}/enrollment-history` | Durable audit trail of Enroll RPC attempts for this node_id |
| GET | `/org/shared-pool` | Whether this organization's jobs may run on GCON's shared worker pool (read-only: GCON changes it on request, an API key cannot) |
| GET | `/receipts` | List all job receipts |
| GET | `/receipts/{receipt_id}` | Get full evidence detail for a single receipt |
| GET | `/telemetry/events` | List job-lifecycle telemetry events |
| GET | `/whoami` | Identify the API key making this request |
| GET | `/workers/leases` | This organization's hosted-worker leases (open ones, and recently ended) |
| POST | `/workers/leases` | Lease GCON-hosted workers: they run this organization's jobs, and only its jobs, until released |
| DELETE | `/workers/leases/{lease_id}` | Release a leased worker. It finishes the job it is running, is cleaned, and returns to GCON's pool |
| GET | `/workflows` | List all workflows |
| POST | `/workflows` | Submit a new workflow (DAG of jobs) |

## Database

Migrations: 1 `initial_control_plane_schema`, 2 `add_org_id_to_nodes_and_jobs`, 3 `billing_staking_webhooks_ha_retention`, 4 `receipt_verification_and_uploaded_at_indexes`, 5 `org_scoped_enroll_tokens`, 6 `telemetry_events`, 7 `node_enrollment_audit`, 8 `job_submission_idempotency_keys`, 9 `node_ed25519_public_key`, 10 `observability_history_and_incidents`, 11 `incident_ownership`, 12 `workflows`, 13 `job_client_reference_and_idempotency_fingerprint`, 14 `org_shared_pool_settings`, 15 `enroll_token_expiry_and_use_limit`, 16 `invoice_line_item_exact_price_and_order`, 17 `node_archived_at`, 18 `hosted_fleet_and_worker_leases`.

### Control plane (`cp.db`)

- `cluster_events`(id, event_type, node_id, job_id, payload_json, created_at)
- `coordinator_leases`(lease_name, holder_id, term, acquired_at, expires_at, updated_at)
- `enroll_tokens`(token_id, org_id, token_hash, label, created_at, revoked_at, expires_at, max_uses, uses, kind)
- `execution_logs`(id, job_id, attempt_id, node_id, stream, sequence, content, logged_at)
- `fleet_nodes`(node_id, enrolled_at, enroll_token_id, held_reason, held_at, sanitizing_since, sanitize_ref)
- `heartbeats`(id, node_id, sequence, status, cpu_percent, memory_percent, running_jobs, received_at)
- `incidents`(incident_id, rule, subject, severity, title, status, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_at, detail_json, owner, owner_at)
- `invoice_line_items`(line_item_id, invoice_id, description, quantity, unit, unit_price_cents, amount_cents, unit_price, position)
- `invoices`(invoice_id, org_id, period_start, period_end, currency, amount_cents, status, provider, provider_charge_id, provider_error, created_at, finalized_at, paid_at)
- `job_attempts`(attempt_id, job_id, node_id, attempt_number, status, request_message_id, dispatched_at, completed_at, error)
- `job_submission_idempotency_keys`(org_id, idempotency_key, job_id, created_at, request_hash)
- `jobs`(job_id, command, status, priority, workflow_id, created_by, timeout_seconds, submitted_at, completed_at, result_json, org_id, callback_url, client_reference)
- `metric_snapshots`(snapshot_id, taken_at, data_json)
- `node_capabilities`(capability_id, node_id, capability_key, capability_value, updated_at)
- `node_enrollment_audit`(id, node_id, org_id, enroll_token_id, source_ip, accepted, reason, created_at)
- `node_stakes`(node_id, bonded_amount, unbonding_amount, unbonding_release_at, slashed_total, updated_at)
- `nodes`(node_id, hostname, status, transport_endpoint, agent_version, auth_fingerprint, registered_at, last_seen_at, draining, metadata_json, org_id, ed25519_public_key, archived_at)
- `org_pool_settings`(org_id, mode, updated_at)
- `receipts`(receipt_id, job_id, attempt_id, node_id, receipt_hash, signature, payload_json, uploaded_at, verified)
- `schema_migrations`(version, name, applied_at)
- `settings`(key, value, updated_at, updated_by)
- `shared_pool_nodes`(node_id, added_by, added_at)
- `stake_events`(event_id, node_id, event_type, amount, reason, job_id, receipt_id, created_at)
- `telemetry_events`(id, event_id, trace_id, job_id, node_id, event_type, level, payload_json, created_at)
- `webhook_deliveries`(delivery_id, subscription_id, org_id, url, secret, job_id, event_type, payload_json, status, attempt_count, response_code, last_error, created_at, last_attempt_at, next_attempt_at)
- `webhook_subscriptions`(subscription_id, org_id, url, secret, event_types_json, active, created_at)
- `worker_leases`(lease_id, node_id, org_id, state, requested_by, started_at, last_activity_at, ending_at, ended_at, end_reason, ended_by, sanitize_result)
- `workflows`(workflow_id, name, org_id, created_by, status, definition_json, state_json, created_at, updated_at)

### Management (users, organizations, API keys)

- `api_keys`(key_id, name, owner_user_id, scopes_json, secret, created_at, expires_at, last_used_at, usage_count, status, secret_hash, secret_masked)
- `audit_log`(entry_id, actor, action, target, timestamp, seq)
- `customer_password_reset_tokens`(token, customer_user_id, created_at, expires_at, used_at)
- `customer_sessions`(token, customer_user_id, created_at, expires_at)

## Plan limits (starting values)

| Plan | requests_per_minute | max_concurrent_jobs | allowed_programs | max_runtime_seconds | max_workers | max_leased_workers | verification |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard (default) | 600 | 50 | ['python', 'python3', 'nvidia-smi', 'echo'] | 3600 | 5 | 1 | False |
| Pro | 3000 | 200 | ['python', 'python3', 'nvidia-smi', 'echo', 'bash', 'sh', 'pip', 'pip3'] | 14400 | 25 | 4 | True |
| Enterprise | 12000 | 1000 | ['*'] | 86400 | 100 | 20 | True |

## Events

`EventType`: `ARTIFACT_REGISTERED`, `CLUSTER_STARTED`, `CLUSTER_STOPPED`, `COORDINATOR_BECAME_LEADER`, `COORDINATOR_LOST_LEADERSHIP`, `EMERGENCY_STOP`, `EXECUTION_DISPUTED`, `FAILED_JOBS_RETRIED`, `HEALTH_CRITICAL`, `HEALTH_DEGRADED`, `HEALTH_RECOVERED`, `JOB_ASSIGNED`, `JOB_CANCELLED`, `JOB_COMPLETED`, `JOB_FAILED`, `JOB_RESUMED_AFTER_RESTART`, `JOB_STARTED`, `JOB_SUBMITTED`, `NODE_BUSY`, `NODE_DEREGISTERED`, `NODE_DRAINING`, `NODE_IDLE`, `NODE_OFFLINE`, `NODE_ONLINE`, `NODE_QUARANTINED`, `NODE_QUARANTINE_CLEARED`, `NODE_REGISTERED`, `NODE_RESTARTED`, `NODE_STAKE_SLASHED`, `POLICY_VIOLATION`, `QUEUE_CLEARED`, `RECEIPT_GENERATED`, `RECEIPT_VERIFICATION_FAILED`, `RECEIPT_VERIFICATION_RECOVERED`, `SCHEDULER_PAUSED`, `SCHEDULER_RESTARTED`, `SCHEDULER_RESUMED`, `WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_FAILED`.

Lease events (published by name): `WORKER_HELD`, `WORKER_LEASE_ENDED`, `WORKER_LEASE_ENDING`, `WORKER_LEASE_STARTED`, `WORKER_RETURNED_TO_POOL`.
